meta.subject: More syntax error fixes and a logic bug with the mb to mem interface.

en.summary: Fixes phase qualification for MMIO-triggered control writes in the FPGA interface: instruction-buffer writes must wait for true dispatch idle, while mb-to-memory data writes must not be blocked by the execute flag.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly mentions a logic bug in the mb-to-mem interface.
The RTL hunk changes write-enable predicates in a hardware register interface, not just comments or syntax.
The changed conditions directly decide when on-chip state updates are accepted.
disqualifiers: The same commit also contains a pure VHDL syntax fix in the wrapper.
This is FPGA integration/control-plane logic rather than the GPU execution datapath, so confidence is lower than for a core datapath bug.
evidence: At MMIO address `9'h008`, the enable condition changes from `~execute` to `dispatch_idle`.
At MMIO address `9'h041`, the enable condition drops the `~execute` requirement entirely.
Both predicates sit in the combinational block that generates `instrBuffWrEn` and `mb2fpgamem_data_we` from AXI-Lite writes.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Accelerator control interfaces often have different legality rules for different MMIO writes. Command-buffer or instruction-buffer writes may only be safe when the dispatch front-end is truly idle, while writes into a staging-memory window may need to stay available during execution. If a design uses one coarse execution-state predicate for both cases, it can wrongly block valid data-window writes or wrongly permit command-buffer mutation before the front-end is actually idle.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Software performs control-plane MMIO writes while execution is active or while dispatch is not yet fully idle.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Use an overly coarse execution-state guard for per-register write enables instead of the correct per-register legality conditions.
portability_notes: Map this to any hardware control block that exposes both command-buffer writes and data-window writes through MMIO.
The bug is about phase qualification, not bus protocol correctness.
A reusable injection can target only one of the affected write classes if a DUT does not expose both.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the decode logic that turns MMIO writes into per-register write strobes.
Identify one register whose writes should wait for dispatcher/front-end idle and one register whose writes should remain allowed during execution.
Replace the specific legality condition with a coarse global execute/not-execute predicate.
Keep the address decode unchanged so the failure remains a timing-of-acceptance bug, not an addressing bug.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AXI-Lite write-enable decode for instruction-buffer and mb-to-memory registers
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix makes instruction-buffer writes depend on `dispatch_idle` and removes the erroneous `~execute` gate from `mb2fpgamem_data_we`.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: The source-level anchor is the `always @(*)` block that drives `instrBuffWrEn` and `mb2fpgamem_data_we` for addresses `9'h008` and `9'h041`.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: MMIO writes are accepted or blocked in the wrong execution phase, causing missed instruction-buffer updates, blocked mb-to-memory transfers, or command mutation at unsafe times.
evidence_for_injection: The two functional edits both change write-acceptance predicates rather than data values.
The wrapper file change is only a VHDL `port map` syntax correction and does not affect the hardware bug mechanism.
The address-specific enable logic shows that the bug is per-register phase qualification, not a generic AXI-Lite handshake defect.
notes: This is still a DUT-relevant RTL bug because the faulty behavior lives in synthesized interface logic.
If a target DUT only has one comparable MMIO path, inject the wrong phase guard on that path alone.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 FPGA 接口中 MMIO 控制写入的阶段限定：instruction buffer 写入必须等待真正的 dispatch idle，而 mb-to-memory 数据写入不应再被 execute 标志错误阻塞。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确提到了 mb-to-mem 接口中的逻辑缺陷。
RTL 补丁修改的是硬件寄存器接口中的写使能条件，而不是注释或纯语法。
这些条件会直接决定片上状态更新何时被接受。
disqualifiers: 同一提交还包含一个纯粹的 VHDL wrapper 语法修复。
该问题位于 FPGA 集成/控制平面，而不是 GPU 执行数据通路，因此置信度低于核心数据通路缺陷。
evidence: 在 MMIO 地址 `9'h008` 上，使能条件从 `~execute` 改为 `dispatch_idle`。
在 MMIO 地址 `9'h041` 上，使能条件完全移除了 `~execute` 要求。
这两个谓词都位于根据 AXI-Lite 写操作生成 `instrBuffWrEn` 和 `mb2fpgamem_data_we` 的组合逻辑块中。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 加速器控制接口通常会对不同 MMIO 写入定义不同的合法时机。命令缓冲区或指令缓冲区写入往往只应在 dispatch 前端真正空闲时发生，而写入暂存内存窗口的数据通道则可能需要在执行期间继续可用。如果设计错误地对两类寄存器都使用同一个粗粒度执行状态谓词，就会把本该允许的数据窗口写入错误阻塞，或者在前端尚未真正空闲时错误允许命令缓冲区被修改。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 控制寄存器写入的阶段限定
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 软件在执行仍然活跃或 dispatch 尚未完全空闲时发起控制平面 MMIO 写入。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 对不同寄存器的写使能错误地使用一个粗粒度的 execute/not-execute 条件，而不是各自正确的合法性条件。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在 MMIO 写使能译码中使用错误阶段保护
portability_notes: 可映射到任何同时通过 MMIO 暴露命令缓冲区写入和数据窗口写入的硬件控制块。
该缺陷关注的是写入时机限定，而不是总线协议本身是否正确。
如果目标 DUT 只暴露其中一种路径，也可以只对那一类写入注入错误阶段保护。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把 MMIO 写操作译码成逐寄存器写 strobe 的逻辑。
识别一个应当等待 dispatcher 或前端空闲的寄存器，以及一个执行期间仍应允许写入的寄存器。
把原本针对该寄存器的特定合法性条件替换为一个粗粒度的全局 execute/not-execute 谓词。
保留地址译码不变，使故障保持为“写入接收时机错误”，而不是地址错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: instruction-buffer 与 mb-to-memory 寄存器的 AXI-Lite 写使能译码
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复使 instruction-buffer 写入依赖 `dispatch_idle`，并移除了 `mb2fpgamem_data_we` 上错误的 `~execute` 门控。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 源级锚点是 `always @(*)` 组合块，其中为地址 `9'h008` 和 `9'h041` 驱动 `instrBuffWrEn` 与 `mb2fpgamem_data_we`。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: MMIO 写入会在错误的执行阶段被接受或阻塞，导致 instruction buffer 更新丢失、mb-to-memory 传输被阻塞，或在不安全时机修改命令状态。
evidence_for_injection: 两个功能性修改都只改变了写接收谓词，而没有改动数据内容。
wrapper 文件中的改动只是 VHDL `port map` 语法修复，与硬件故障机制无关。
按地址区分的写使能逻辑说明该缺陷属于“逐寄存器阶段限定错误”，而不是通用的 AXI-Lite 握手缺陷。
notes: 虽然这是接口逻辑，但错误行为确实存在于可综合的 DUT RTL 中。
如果目标 DUT 只有一种可比的 MMIO 路径，可只在那条路径上注入错误阶段保护。
